_comment: Turns 3.58% of this hut's 11 rocky_dirt blocks into a buried saibaman seed. The per-block figure is derived, not guessed: (1-p)^11 = 0.67, so two huts in three hold none and the rest hold 1 to 3. More than 3 is under a fifth of a percent. Then hut_saibaman_crops grows visible crops: a 33% chance of one growing seed at the floor centre and a 33% chance of 1 to 3 more, the same as a hut on a generated planet.
